headline: Norwood Pond bridge construction and controlled burn, Sally Milligan trail extension, and Camp Paradise vernal pool initiatives.
summary: The agenda covers the Norwood Pond Bridge and a Norwood Pond controlled burn. It also covers trail plans in Ward 6 and initiatives around the Camp Paradise facility at 44 Cole Street.
items: Updates from the Planning Board, Conservation Commission, Community Preservation Committee, Harbor Management Authority, and Parks & Recreation Commission
Ward 5: update on Norwood Pond Bridge construction, Assessors Map 82 Lot 9
Ward 5: purchase of materials from Tractor Supply Company
Ward 5: meeting with North Shore Music Theater (NSMT) about access to the rear of the property
Ward 5: discussion on Norwood Pond controlled burn, Assessors Map 82 Lot 9

Ward 6: discussion about trail extension in Sally Milligan to Cross Lane/Boyles Street intersection and trail rerouting/improvements on Cross Lane Soccer Field trail, Assessors Map 33 Parcel 7 and Assessors Map 33 Parcel 6
Ward 6: initiatives around Camp Paradise facility and certification of the vernal pool, 44 Cole Street, Assessors Map 45 Lot 42
Discussion on accomplishing goals from the 7 Year Action Plan in the 2022 City of Beverly Open Space Plan
Approval of 2027 Open Space and Recreation Committee meeting schedule
location: Temporary City Hall – First Floor Large Conference Room, 175 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA 01915
